verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only fragments of settlement legibility. Circle Mint converts USD to and from USDC at no additional cost, which a community note corroborates as minting and redeeming at par. CCTP exposes an API to query Fast Transfer fees, and CPN and Gateway are described as near-instant or instant. None of this amounts to documented payment-to-available-balance timing, a published per-rail fee schedule, or accounting statements. Missing for 10: documented settlement timing from payment to available balance, a published fee schedule per rail (the pricing page only offers solution guidance), statements or exportable reports for accounting, and independent corroboration.
